						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b41ae66 elementor-align-center elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="b41ae66" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h4 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">ACCOMMODATION</h4>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4f64e40 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="4f64e40" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">

							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-66834a3 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="66834a3" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;opal-move-up&quot;}" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					        <div class="elementor-text-editor elementor-clearfix"><div style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #545454; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: medium;">Ikarus is an ecological hotel and camping site located only 20 minutes north of Cancun´s downtown in the Chacmuchuch lagoon Natural Reserve.</span></div><div> </div><p style="text-align: left;">You can stay in one of our 10 rooms: <br />1 room with king size, <br />2 rooms with 2 full size beds, <br />3 rooms with 1 full size bed + 1 single bed and <br />4 rooms with one full size bed and 2 single beds.</p><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>All rooms have a private bathroom, hot shower, free WI-FI, fan. </strong><br /><strong>(sorry NO Air conditioned)</strong></p><p style="text-align: left;">We generate our own electricity with a solar system you can also Camp in one of our tents (or in your own), or sleep in a <a href="https://www.google.com/search?q=hammock&amp;sxsrf=APwXEdcb-qejuUKZRMVRdbtZOd6dTCfjzw:1684866682795&amp;source=lnms&amp;tbm=isch&amp;sa=X&amp;ved=2ahUKEwjwuPzAiYz_AhWflmoFHeefCacQ_AUoAnoECAEQBA&amp;biw=1440&amp;bih=821&amp;dpr=2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">hammock</a> “Mexican style”. Camping, RV and eco-travelers welcome….</p><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Swimming pool – Beach – Garden – Kids Playground – Bar – Restaurant – Amazing Sunsets – S.U.P – Kayaks – Kiteboarding Meditation.</strong></p></div>
        				</div>
